evidence.description: The presenter states that meeting action items are frequently lost because nobody owns them.
The presenter claims an on-device model extracts tasks and syncs them to an issue tracker.
A web application UI is shown on screen with a task list.
The presenter says a live demo recorded a sentence and the extracted task appeared in the web app.
The presenter names concrete next steps: calendar integration and a beta with three pilot teams.
A slide titled 'Architecture' with a three-box diagram is visible.
